data.name: Minarul
data.gender_notes: Minarul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Minarul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'minar' which means 'moon' and 'rul' meaning 'light'. This name signifies the gentle, calming light of the moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is associated with the god Chandra or Shiva and represents peace, tranquility, and fertility. The name Minarul carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Minarul usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the peaceful and calming influence of the moon.
data.etymology: Minarul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minarul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
